In the past, when we talked about cloud, what were we discussing? Initially, it was about how to migrate servers to the cloud. Later, it shifted to running AI on the cloud—buying GPUs, tuning models, and setting up inference services. You might recall that around this time last year, the focus was still on which cloud provider had the cheapest GPUs, how low the model inference latency was, and whether computing power supply was sufficient. But this year, the industry's questions have completely transformed. A major change in the cloud computing industry this year is that everyone is now discussing how to enable agents to autonomously use the cloud. On May 20th, in Hangzhou, Leiphone.com attended the Alibaba Cloud Summit and observed that Alibaba Cloud had put this issue on the table, providing a systematic answer. From launching the super node server equipped with the self-developed chip Zhenwu M890, releasing the top domestic flagship model Qwen3.7-Max, upgrading the Bailian inference platform, to introducing over 100 cloud product skills, building agent-native infrastructure, and rewriting the cloud entry point, Alibaba Cloud is thoroughly rebuilding the entire infrastructure from chips to entry points for agents. Notably, just last week, Alibaba's financial report revealed that AI revenue had achieved triple-digit growth for 11 consecutive quarters, and the Bailian platform's ARR had exceeded 8 billion yuan. On the day of the announcement, Alibaba's stock price surged by 8%. According to a source in the cloud computing industry, "Alibaba Cloud holds the largest scale in the MaaS market for large models."

excerpt_i18n.en: Today's AI is already impressive. It can write articles, generate code, and create images in seconds, as well as break down tasks, call tools, and provide solutions like an assistant. For many, the future of AI seems clear: higher efficiency, lower costs, less human labor, and increasingly automated production processes. However, Hua Xiansheng, Dean of the Institute of Engineering Intelligence at Tongji University, sees a different side. In his view, the real challenge for AI is not whether it can "speak like a human," but whether it can enter real systems that cannot be solved by language fluency alone. The engineering world is such a system—it concerns whether buildings are safe, bridges are reliable, traffic is smooth, energy can be stably dispatched, and cities can operate continuously. There are no simple standard answers here, nor can hallucinations be passed off as creativity. Even if an AI model can produce a perfect plan, it does not mean it understands the engineering site. Therefore, the first question engineering intelligence must answer is: How can AI move from the digital world to the physical world? Dean Hua believes that engineering intelligence is not a simple combination of AI and engineering. It must not only use existing AI technologies to solve engineering problems but also derive new AI theories and methods from complex engineering systems. Moreover, these capabilities must be solidified into platforms, models, intelligent agents, and operating systems, enabling engineering intelligence to scale from single-point breakthroughs to widespread replication. Para muchos, el futuro de la IA parece ya claro: mayor eficiencia, menores costos, menos mano de obra y procesos de producción cada vez más automatizados. items.title: 智象未来超两千亿参数图像大模型HiDream-O1-Image-Pro发布，融资持续提速
items.raw_excerpt: 5月19日，北京。 智象未来举办首届开放日，主题为“ Imaging the World ”。在开放日上，智象未来正式发布基于新一代原生全模态模型架构 Unified Transformer（ UiT ）打造的图像大模型 HiDream-O1-Image-Pro。这一超2千亿参数的原生全模态图像大模型，不仅在多个基准测试中刷新 SOTA 纪录，也标志着智象未来正向图像、视频、文本、音频等多模态统一建模的“原生全模态”阶段迈进。   同时，智象未来宣布完成新一轮亿级融资，深创投、金浦投资、财鑫资本、复聚资本等多家机构参与。这是智象未来半个月内再次完成融资，体现出资本市场对原生全模态大模型方向的持续看好。随着视觉生成、具身智能等前沿技术加速融合，世界模型成为 AI 演进的重要方向，智象未来在底层模型架构、产品化能力与产业生态布局上的持续突破，也获得了市场进一步认可。   200B+ 参数图像大模型HiDream-O1-Image-Pro 发布，原生全模态架构全面升级   当前，图像生成模型正从传统 U-Net 架构迈向扩散 Transformer（ DiT ）时代。以潜在扩散模型（LDM）为代表的主流路线，通过 VAE 压缩图像、独立语言模型编码文本，在效率和生成能力上取得显著进展，但图像与文本分离编码的方式，也使模型在复杂语义理解、高保真细节还原、精准文字渲染、多任务泛化等方面面临天然瓶颈。   面向这一挑战，智象未来正式发布基于原生全模态架构的 200B＋ 参数闭源图像大模型 HiDream-O1-Image-Pro。不同于传统碎片化、多模块拼接的编码范式，HiDream-O1-Image-Pro 将原始图像像素、离散文本标记和任 务条件统一纳入连续共享标记空间，实现图像、文本与多任务条件在底层表征上的深度融合。这一架构突破进一步释放

excerpt_i18n.en:
On May 19, in Beijing, ZhiXiang Future held its first Open Day themed "Imaging the World." During the event, the company officially launched HiDream-O1-Image-Pro, an image large model built on the next-generation native full-modal architecture Unified Transformer (UiT). This native full-modal image large model, with over 200 billion parameters, not only sets new SOTA records across multiple benchmarks but also marks ZhiXiang Future's advancement toward unified modeling of images, videos, text, audio, and other modalities in the "native full-modal" stage.  

Meanwhile, ZhiXiang Future announced the completion of a new round of financing worth hundreds of millions of yuan, with participation from institutions including Shenzhen Capital Group, Jinpu Investment, Caixin Capital, and Fuju Capital. This marks another financing round for ZhiXiang Future within half a month, reflecting the capital market's continued optimism for the direction of native full-modal large models.
